data.gender_notes: Azrahun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name of Allah, meaning the one who is radiant, glowing, and bright. The name Azrahun carries the meaning “The Bright One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azrahun usually hope their child will grow to embody the bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Azrahun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Bright One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azrahun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_urdu.name: ازراهون

in_hindi.name: अज़राहुन

in_pashto.name: ازرهون

This name serves as a powerful inspiration to seek knowledge, wisdom, and the love of Allah, as well as a reminder of the skyward journey that every believer must embark upon to strive towards His eternal and true pleasure. Additionally, the name may serve as an affirmation of one's faith in the unseen, subtle, and brilliant nature of the Divine, which can guide individuals towards spiritual growth and development.

It is a reminder of the importance of maintaining a strong spiritual connection with the Creator, and striving to live in accordance with His will.
